title: Murine cochlear cell sorting and cell-type-specific organoid culture
protocol: Rinse the nozzle with 70% ethanol to ensure sterile sorting.
Clean the sample path by running FACSClean (10% bleach).
Run FACSRinse and deionized water prior to loading samples.
Set cell size and granularity parameters to exclude small and low granular particles.
Start with the negative control tube to adjust parameter voltages and gates.
Use phycoerythrin (PE) and fluorescein isothiocyanate (FITC) emission filters for detecting tdTomato and GFP.
Load the negative sample control tube and acquire data until a few thousand events are represented on the FACS plot.
Load the Fgfr3-tdTomato/Sox2-GFP sample tube and acquire the data.
Load negative control tube and record data to document specificity.
Load Fgfr3-tdTomato/Sox2-GFP sample tube and record data.
Define sorting gates.
Isolate greater epithelial ridge cells with gate G1 (mainly lateral-intermediate GER cells).
Isolate medial GER cells with gate G2.
Contain pillar cells and Deiters’ cells with gate G3.
Contain pillar cells and hair cells with gate G4.
Place gates G1–G4 into areas where no cells are detected in the negative control dot plot.
Incubate sorted cells in a 96-well plate at 37°C in a humidified atmosphere with 5% CO2 for 7 days.
Change the medium every other day as described in steps 8–11.
Prepare maintenance medium by adding fresh growth factors, small molecules, and recombinant proteins to DMEM/F-12/N-2/B-27/Amp medium.
Prewarm the medium to 37°C in the cell culture incubator for 20 minutes.
Remove 80 μL of old medium per well carefully.
Aspirate media from the surface without disturbing attached organoids.
Add 100 μL of fresh medium per well.
Place the dish back into the incubator.
Transfer organoids to an 8-well Lab-Tek glass chamber slide pre-coated with Matrigel at culture day 7.
Allow organoids to attach and spread out on the chamber bottom for the following 14 days.
Prepare maintenance medium with freshly added growth factors, small molecules, and recombinant proteins to DMEM/F-12/N-2/B-27/Amp medium.
Prewarm the medium to 37°C in the cell culture incubator for 20 minutes.
Coat the chamber bottom with Matrigel.
Thaw Matrigel on ice.
Dilute Matrigel ten times with ice-cold DMEM using pre-cooled pipette tips.
Fill chamber wells with diluted and cold Matrigel until it covers the chamber bottom.
Incubate the chamber at 18°C–24°C for 1 h.
Aspirate Matrigel from the chamber.
Rinse the chamber with 400 μL DMEM/F12.
Add 400 μL fresh maintenance medium per well.
Remove 100 μL medium from a single well of the 96-well plate containing 7-day-old organoids.
Transfer the remaining 100 μL of medium with all organoids from the single well into a single chamber well.
Use a regular 200 μL pipette tip for this transfer procedure.
Incubate the chamber slides at 37°C in a humidified atmosphere with 5% CO2.
Prepare new maintenance medium with freshly added growth factors, small molecules, and recombinant proteins to DMEM/F-12/N-2/B-27/Amp medium.
Prewarm the medium to 37°C in the cell culture incubator for 20 minutes.
Aspirate approximately 90% of the old medium from the wells.
Add 500 μL of fresh medium to each well.
Place the chamber slide back into the incubator.
